source occurrence, then append only unseen tail beyond the saved boundary. Do not
call existing PlaylistPages.next on every playback transition: it requests around
the last LOADED source row and would fetch too far ahead. Cannot simply replace
our panel with the returned account playlist: current local navigation endpoints
are video-only; NativeQueueEngineHook intentionally preserves local backend when
server responses arrive. Full replacement would lose local edits/merged entries.

retained native Video. PlaylistPage.Row has native Anchor (list/video/index/entry/
params/tracking), but PlaylistQueue.fromPage/appendPage discard per-row anchors.

original-occurrence + source-origin ownership retained per entry, surviving edits,
merge, Undo and duplicate video/list copies. Never use queue selectedIndex as the
source playlist index; never infer membership by video ID alone. Current response
not extending tail is a no-op, not EOF or error. Preserve token/account/backend
ownership and cancellation; no blocking main-thread waits.

# Latest authoritative correction — original Android uses action shuffle in user's session

User observed original Android app shuffle visibly reorders both queue/saved playlist and then plays displayed order, and requested reinvestigation. Verified both stock APK native headers have TWO paths. Presence of playlist header shuffle command => click executes command with ALLOW_RELOAD=true instead of toggling local maps; state painter forces selected=false (action button). Otherwise original listener toggles active service local shuffle. Our generated Panel/proto omits native header command; we enable fallback capability, so ours uses hidden native permutation. This explains actual behavior discrepancy. Earlier "keep original visible order because native" inference was unjustified. User observation + exact native action path supports mobile understanding; don't universalize every account/playlist or claim remote permutation captured.

# Shuffle edit investigation — recalculation already present

Current user asks whether add/remove/reorder leave native shuffle order stale. Traced all three runtime mutation paths and native bridge: changed entry lists call patch_attachQueue; it captures repeat/shuffle, disables shuffle and nulls both link arrays, synchronously accepts updated rows and selection, restores shuffle (native setter rebuilds maps), then refreshes native availability and player/media/fullscreen controls. Selection/metadata-only updates preserve maps intentionally. No production edits, commit, build or push for this investigation; active feature HEAD 5ebe8dda0 remains clean.

Same relationship in 21.20 aojj.t decompilation under /workspace/scratch/native-playlist-inspection/java. Native shuffle setter rebuilds only when maps null; stock field-reference scan shows map/start writes only in shuffle setter and navigator teardown, not observer callbacks. Native observers refresh availability but do not rebuild maps automatically. Thus no missing recalculation found for ordinary distinct-video mutations, including reorder. No on-device reproduction or proof actual Premium queue routes every edit through this same path; do not claim equivalence. User's counted fresh seven-entry traversal was correct; edit case still uncounted and added-video playback uncertain. No forced wrap or speculative fix.
